question: Choose the misspelt word from the given options.
solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. Inevitible .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **“Inevitible”** is misspelt in the given options.
 
• The correct spelling of the word should be **“Inevitable”**, which means something that is certain to happen or unavoidable.
 
• All other options—**Credible, Invisible, and Plausible**—are correctly spelt.

Correct sentence: *The misspelt word is **Inevitible**, and it should be corrected to **Inevitable**.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Spelling Tips:**
 
 
• To avoid spelling errors, break down the word into syllables (e.g., "In-ev-it-able").
 
• Memorize common prefixes like "In-" and suffixes like "-able."
 
 
 
• **Usage:**
 
 
• The word "inevitable" can be used in sentences such as: *"The outcome of the match was inevitable."*
 
• It is often used to describe events that are certain to occur.
